gaps.explanation: Governmental funds statement p4 (printed p12) Total receipts: General 9,110,396 + Street Department 1,642,635 + Economic Development 346,026 + Recreational Agency 1,222,751 + Debt Service 673,430 + Community Development Agency 87,093 = 13,082,331. Detail has the budget schedules pp8-10 (General 9,096,846, Street Department 1,642,635, Economic Development 346,026 = 11,085,507). Missing: (1) the Recreational Agency, Debt Service and Community Development Agency columns, which have no schedule (1,222,751 + 673,430 + 87,093 = 1,983,274); (2) the General Fund budget schedule p8 leaves out the General column's 'TIF project property taxes' 13,550 printed on p4 (9,110,396 - 9,096,846 = 13,550). Fix: add the printed non-zero rows. Recreational Agency: Taxes 922,751 + Miscellaneous 300,000; Debt Service: Taxes 637,146 + State revenue 36,284; Community Development Agency: TIF project property taxes 12,869 + Charges for services 73,937 + Investment income 287; General: TIF project property taxes 13,550. The two 'Taxes' cells have no printed breakdown by fund (the p2 split of the Total Taxes row does not divide exactly by fund), so they get category taxes. Check: 11,085,507 + 1,222,751 + 673,430 + 87,093 + 13,550 = 13,082,331.
